tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Find a US airport by name, city, ICAO or IATA code — or every field within reach of one, filtered by usable runway length. Covers the fields a business jet can actually use (847 in the reference set). Indicative broker estimate. AviationHS is an air charter broker under 14 CFR Part 295, not a direct air carrier. Not an offer of air transportation until an operating carrier confirms in writing.

query.description: Name, city, ICAO or IATA code.

near_icao.description: Return fields near this one instead, nearest first.

min_runway_ft.description: Only fields with at least this much hard-surface runway.

tools.name: list_aircraft
tools.description: The reference fleet with published range, cruise, wingspan and balanced field length, plus an indicative hourly range. Indicative broker estimate. AviationHS is an air charter broker under 14 CFR Part 295, not a direct air carrier. Not an offer of air transportation until an operating carrier confirms in writing.

slug.description: Exactly one aircraft, by slug — e.g. "global-7500".

pax.description: Only aircraft that seat at least this many passengers.

min_range_nm.description: Only aircraft with at least this much NBAA IFR range.

max_wingspan_ft.description: Only aircraft narrow enough for a span-limited field.

class.description: Turboprop, Very light, Light, Midsize, Super-mid, Heavy or Ultra-long.

tools.name: check_runway
tools.description: Whether one aircraft can use one field, accounting for elevation and any published wingspan or weight limit. Returns the reason, not just a boolean — the answer is usually 'yes but with a payload penalty', which a boolean cannot say. Planning aid only: the operating carrier and its pilot in command decide. Indicative broker estimate. AviationHS is an air charter broker under 14 CFR Part 295, not a direct air carrier. Not an offer of air transportation until an operating carrier confirms in writing.

icao.description: Airport, by ICAO code or city.

tools.name: estimate_flight_time
tools.description: Great-circle distance with the standard routing allowance, divided by published cruise, plus ground time — and whether the leg needs a fuel stop. Indicative broker estimate. AviationHS is an air charter broker under 14 CFR Part 295, not a direct air carrier. Not an offer of air transportation until an operating carrier confirms in writing.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a trip: every aircraft in the reference fleet that carries the party, with the ones that cannot use either runway excluded and the reason given. Includes crew, landing and handling, the daily minimum and the 7.5% federal excise tax. Indicative broker estimate. AviationHS is an air charter broker under 14 CFR Part 295, not a direct air carrier. Not an offer of air transportation until an operating carrier confirms in writing.

from.description: Departure field, by ICAO code or city.

to.description: Arrival field, by ICAO code or city.

date.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Recorded, not yet priced seasonally.
